name: Facebook & Meta competitor ad alerts to Telegram (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Facebook & Meta competitor ad alerts to Telegram

This workflow runs the locked Luminar Facebook & Meta Ads Library Actor once, verifies the result against the Actor's authoritative RUN_SUMMARY, and sends a concise Telegram receipt. It is built for repeat competitor-ad monitoring, not blind one-page scraping.

### How it works

1. A manual test or inactive daily schedule reaches one editable settings node.
2. Fail-closed preflight validates the chat ID, targets, enums, result limit, and finite charge cap before any paid Actor call.
3. The Actor runs once with retries disabled and an immutable build tag.
4. n8n reads RUN_SUMMARY for target coverage, baseline state, charged events, and the exact PPE buyer charge.
5. Dataset pages are planned from the summary, fetched in bounded pages, deduplicated, and reconciled before Telegram delivery.

### Setup

- [ ] Install the verified Apify community node.
- [ ] Select one Apify OAuth2 credential on all three Apify nodes.
- [ ] Select one Telegram credential on the final node.
- [ ] Replace the Telegram chat ID and edit the targets in Monitoring settings.
- [ ] Run manually, inspect the run link and exact charge, then activate the schedule only if the receipt is correct.

The first Changes run creates a baseline and never claims that all current ads are newly launched. Incomplete or capped coverage never becomes a “nothing changed” message.

## 1. Configure safely

Start manually or on an inactive schedule. Edit one settings node; preflight validates every value before paid work.

nodes.name: Section 2 - Run once and verify status

parameters.content:
## 2. Run once and verify status

Runs the exact Actor build once with no paid retry, classifies every terminal state, then reads RUN_SUMMARY.

## 3. Prove full output

Validates RUN_SUMMARY, plans bounded dataset pages, and retrieves every intended row without silent truncation.

## 4. Reconcile and notify

Reconciles targets, coverage, rows, baseline state, and exact PPE charge before one retryable Telegram delivery.
